scope: Paired synthetic development diagnosis, not final thesis qualification
decision_reason: Neither case passes all independent checks; both candidate self-test suites fail. Static source acceptance on one case is not executable success.

sampling.syntax_retries: At most one audited retry per file, unchanged production policy

comparison_controls.health_change_reason: real_runtime.py now accepts an explicitly identified proposer adapter. Shared model server also changed to select named adapters; no claim of bit-identical serving code.
comparison_controls.opaque_project_and_provenance_UUIDs: Fresh UUIDs per run; semantic inputs/oracles unchanged, prompts are not byte-identical.

candidate.source_status_scope: Original production syntax/static-structure validation only; no execution success implied

findings: Candidate retains a globally declared createGuestList with guarded CommonJS export, so the independent classic-script availability group now passes (baseline failed). This VM has no document and does not verify DOM behavior.

Candidate exports createGuestList() instead of the required named factory export. All three independent state/contract groups fail with TypeError: createGuestList is not a function. This does not prove that the underlying in-memory algorithm is wrong.

Both candidate Node tests are registered; one passes and the second genuinely fails when it calls the exported service object as a function. No caught-assertion false-success pattern was observed. Baseline had eleven different passing self-tests; their counts are not directly comparable.

Candidate HTML is rejected by the original structure validator. Source inspection shows no closing style element and missing required screen/control structure. No rendered-browser execution was performed.
Static inspection of candidate app.js also finds a read() call with no definition in the submitted files; the independent core-only VM does not exercise that document branch.

candidate.source_status_scope: Original production syntax/static-structure validation only; no execution success implied

findings: Candidate core needed one audited syntax retry, then passed original syntax/static-structure admission. Baseline stopped after two ESM core attempts and never generated HTML or model tests.

Candidate independent numeric validation and classic-script availability pass. Its exact-allocation and conservation groups fail with TypeError: Assignment to constant variable because splitExpense decrements const remainder. Baseline passed the allocation groups but failed integer-input validation and classic-script startup: equal 2/4 totals hide different behavior.

Both candidate model-authored tests are registered: real-outputs test fails on the same const mutation; invalid-input test passes. Passing static admission therefore does not demonstrate a functioning application.

Original HTML validator skips TEXT elements: it accepts the expected ELM-004 result marker placed on a link in the first screen instead of the result output in the second screen. Native HTML also repeats id=back. This is a validator defect independently observed in the unchanged native candidate.

Static inspection finds submit initially disabled without enabling logic and result hidden through CSS without a corresponding reveal. No DOM/browser behavior was executed by this frozen benchmark; these are inspection findings, not measured browser outcomes.

aggregate_quality_score_reason: Test groups assess different properties; small stochastic sample and unequal generated self-tests do not support a promotion score.
limitations: One stochastic sample per case; no statistical claim of reliable improvement or throughput.
Cases were excluded from training but have now informed diagnosis; further tuning makes them development checks, not untouched final qualification.
Core VM checks omit document, rendering, CSS and actual event behavior.
The original source status is retained even where manual review exposes a validator gap; any validator replay must be recorded separately.
next_experiment: Keep candidate weights and native failures; restore previously selected proposer for the demo.
Correct static marker and duplicate-ID admission in a separate change with replay results, without rewriting original benchmark evidence.
Measure a stronger real coding model on new frozen applications before committing remaining budget to a larger training run; include actual browser submit/back/result behavior.
